KarteaPathConfig

class KarteaPathConfig[source]

Bases: PathConfig

Path configuration specific to the KarTEA game.

Inherits all the logic of PathConfig. Class with only class attributes and class methods: it is not instantiated.

Attributes:
KARTEA_CONFIG_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Name of the configuration file (“kartea.ini”).

KARTEA_LOG_FILENAMEstr, class attribute

Name of the log file (“kartea.log”).

KARTEA_DIRPath, class attribute

KarTEA data folder (PathConfig.EXERGAME_DIR / "kartea").

KARTEA_LOG_DIRPath, class attribute

Log folder.

KARTEA_RESOURCES_DIRPath, class attribute

Folder of the user’s resources (images, sounds, phases).

KARTEA_IMAGES_DIRPath, class attribute

Folder of the user’s images.

KARTEA_SOUNDS_DIRPath, class attribute

Folder of the user’s sounds.

KARTEA_PHASES_DIRPath, class attribute

Folder of the user’s phase CSV files (priority over the built-in ones).

KARTEA_PLAYER_DIRPath, class attribute

Folder of the per-player CSV files.

KARTEA_MODS_DIRPath, class attribute

Custom resources (images and sounds) placed by the user.

KARTEA_CONFIG_FILEPath, class attribute

Full path of kartea.ini.

classmethod ensure_kartea_dirs()[source]

Create all the folders KarTEA needs.

Notes

Also creates the PathConfig folders, the default kartea.ini (if missing) and the mods folders with their README files.

classmethod ensure_mods_dirs()[source]

Create the mods folder, its subfolders and README files.

Notes

One subfolder per resource field and the README in Portuguese, English and Spanish (each created only if it does not exist yet, so user notes are not overwritten). OSError is ignored: the game works without the folder.

static kartea_resource(path='')[source]

Return a Qt resource path under :/kartea.

Parameters:
pathstr, optional

Relative path inside the resource prefix.

Returns:
str

:/kartea/{path} without a trailing slash.

Examples

>>> KarteaPathConfig.kartea_resource("images")
':/kartea/images'
>>> KarteaPathConfig.kartea_resource()
':/kartea'

classmethod get_phase_source(phase_id)[source]

Return where the CSV of a phase is read from.

Parameters:
phase_idint

Id of the phase.

Returns:
dict[str, str]

{"type": "file", "path": ...} when the user’s phases folder has {phase_id}.csv; otherwise {"type": "resource", "path": ":/phases/{phase_id}"}.

classmethod read_phase_data(phase_id)[source]

Return the CSV content of a phase.

Parameters:
phase_idint

Id of the phase.

Returns:
str | None

The CSV text, or None if it cannot be read.

Notes

The user’s file takes priority over the built-in resource (see get_phase_source). The user’s file is read as UTF-8 with or without BOM; any error reading it returns None.

Values come from the single table KarteaIniDefaults.TABLE (util/inidefaults.py). An existing file is never changed.

classmethod find_builtin_for_field(field, name)[source]

Return the Qt path of a built-in resource of field.

Searches name only in the field’s builtin_dir (e.g. “:/sounds/feedback/positive”), so that an equal name in another folder is not chosen.

Parameters:
fieldstr

Field name, as in KarteaResourceFields.ALL.

namestr

Resource name.

Returns:
str

The Qt path, or “” if name is empty or does not exist there.

classmethod list_mod_for_field(field)[source]

Return the files of the field’s mods folder.

Only files directly in the folder, with the extensions accepted for the field. The displayed name has an extension, so it never matches a built-in resource (.qrc aliases have no extension).

Parameters:
fieldstr

Field name, as in KarteaResourceFields.ALL.

Returns:
list[tuple[str, str]]

[(name, path)] sorted by name (case-insensitive); empty if the folder cannot be read.

classmethod find_mod_for_field(field, name)[source]

Parameters:
fieldstr

namestr

File name only (no folders), with an extension accepted for the field.

Returns:
str

The file path, or “” if name is invalid or the file does not exist.

classmethod resolve_for_field_or_default(field, name)[source]

Return the path of a field resource, or of its default.

Like resolve_for_field, but uses the field default (KarteaResourceFields.ALL) when name is empty or no longer exists (e.g. a file deleted from the mods folder).

Parameters:
fieldstr

Field name, as in KarteaResourceFields.ALL.

namestr

Resource name.

Returns:
str

The resolved path, or “” if even the default does not exist.
